Common heating issues

No heat or weak airflow

We test igniters, sensors, and blower motors, then verify gas pressure and duct static to restore full output.

Short cycling

We pinpoint undersized returns, dirty coils, or incorrect thermostat placement that causes premature shutoff.

High energy bills

We recalibrate, seal ducts, and recommend right-sized, high-efficiency options to reduce runtime and waste.
